summary.text: Gregg Bush is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 50, who assumed office on January 8, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gregg Bush earned a bachelor's degree from Illinois Wesleyan University in 1997.
His career experience includes working as a nurse, and he has been affiliated with the Missouri Nurses Association Advocacy Institute and the Laborers' International Union.
In the Missouri House, Bush was assigned to the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee and the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee for 2025-2026.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Bush said he had lived in Columbia for 18 years and listed his priorities as advocating for healthcare professionals and their patients, followed by protecting working families and public schools.
